text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#84721 - hosted-inference - high error rate (sev=page). Details: 5xx spike in us-west1, threshold breached 3m ago. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incident/PD-84721

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: primary on-call (maya) paged. If not acknowledged within 5m, will escalate to secondary.

maya (oncall): ack — I'm on it, pulling logs and metrics. Notify if you need a hand.

leila (eng): saw the spike in traces, tailing logs now. Looks like many requests hitting the hosted-inference autoscaler and failing with OOM on decoder.

maya (oncall): good catch. can we confirm which infra pool? us-west-1/gpu-pool-3?

leila (eng): yep that's the pool. errors look like `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` starting at ~10:42 UTC. Also KV cache growth for long-chat sessions.

sam (secondary): i'm available but haven't received an ack page — PD shows escalation queued. I can join if maya wants to hand off.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation triggered: secondary (sam) paged — no ack after 5m, scheduling manager escalation.

jin (manager): paging in — on call chain now. if primary can't ack we'll take manager escalation and coordinate customer comms.

maya (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) scale up gpu-pool-3 by +2 nodes, 2) enable model fallback to small-lm-v1 for long context requests, 3) enable strict token limit on hosted routes. doing 1 now.

leila (eng): i can push a temporary model-override via the routing feature to route requests > 2048 tokens to small-lm-v1. will prepare config.

maya (oncall): running scale command now:

```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment gpu-pool-3 --replicas=6
# or when using autoscaler
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling gpu-pool-3-group --max-num-replicas=6
```

ops-bot: Started node resize job: request id resize-176995. ETA ~3m.

pagerduty: Manager escalation: jin paged at 10:50 UTC (auto-escalation).

sam (secondary): I see manager page. I'm standing by for handoff or to run mitigation steps if maya needs rest.

maya (oncall): node resize completed — new nodes joined, but error rate only partially reduced. still seeing OOMs in the older pinned instances.

leila (eng): found a dodgy model artifact that retains large KV cache for system prompts. I'm rolling a quick hotfix to cap KV cache growth. patch: `kv_cache.max_entries=512` and restart workers gracefully.

maya (oncall): apply patch and restart workers with rolling restart:

```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/hosted-inference KV_CACHE_MAX=512
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/hosted-inference
```

leila (eng): applied patch, rolling restart started.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgment missing for secondary within window — manager escalation still active.

jin (manager): confirming customer impact so we can update status page. maya, sam — can you estimate number of affected customers and endpoints?

maya (oncall): preliminary: errors visible on inbound generation and chat routes. From metrics, ~12 tenant IDs had elevated 5xx rates over the last 15m. Top customers: corp-alpha (US), beta-saas (APAC test shard). Embeddings endpoints appear unaffected.

sam (secondary): confirmed corp-alpha sent multiple retries; we've seen burst traffic from a scheduled job. I recommend throttling by client-id for now.

maya (oncall): doing temporary rate-limit tweak to 10q/s per api_key for generation routes.

leila (eng): applied routing override to fallback model for long-context sessions. That reduced CPU and memory pressure by ~30% on new requests.

ops-bot: Traffic reroute executed: 14% of traffic moved to dedicated fallback model small-lm-v1.

pagerduty: Incident PD-84721 acknowledged by maya at 10:55 UTC. Manager jin remains notified.

maya (oncall): handoff: i'll continue triage for next 30m, then hand to sam for extended follow-up and postmortem. creating incident issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-412

sam (secondary): i'll take the follow-up, will coordinate postmortem and customer comms. can someone collect request IDs and sample logs for affected tenants?

leila (eng): zipping logs now, linking artifacts to the incident ticket. also saving heap snapshots from problematic pods: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/84721/

jin (manager): good work. please prepare an initial status update for customers: include mitigation steps, ETA for full recovery, and guidance on whether to retry. target: 11:15 UTC.

maya (oncall): will post status: we temporarily routed traffic and scaled pool; patch applied to limit KV cache; error rates are decreasing but some 500s observed. No data loss. ETA for full recovery 30-60m.

sam (secondary): leaving a note for oncall rotation: ensure autoscaler config has cushion +2 for peak windows. we'll add a proactive alert for KV cache growth.

leila (eng): plan to add a regression alert on `kv_cache.entries > 400` and a heuristic that warns before OOM cascade.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved -> PD-84721 closed at 11:22 UTC (resolved by maya).

maya (oncall): resolved — error rate back to baseline. handing complete to sam for postmortem follow-up.

sam (secondary): acknowledged handoff, will run the postmortem and track follow-ups: add autoscaler margin, add KV cache alert, add routing policy test.

jin (manager): thanks everyone. please add timeline and RCA to INC-2026-412 and assign owners.

leila (eng): adding fix PR for KV cap and unit test for cache behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/6123

maya (oncall): closing thread — good job. reactions: :thumbsup: :coffee:
